latin_petition_normalized: Plenum, quaesumus Domine, in nobis remedium tuae miserationis operare: ac tales nos esse perfice propitius, et sic foveri; ut tibi in omnibus placere valeamus.
latin_full:
Plenum, quaesumus Domine, in nobis remedium tuae miserationis operare: ac tales nos esse perfice propitius, et sic foveri; ut tibi in omnibus placere valeamus.
Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
R. Amen.
study_english_full:
Work in us, we pray, O Lord, the full remedy of your mercy, and graciously form and sustain us so that we may please you in all things.
Through Christ our Lord.
R. Amen.
